question: The total cost of producing $x$ items is $C(x)=0.004x^3+0.02x^2+25x+1000$ rupees.(a) Obtain the marginal-cost function.(b) Calculate the marginal cost when $10$ items are produced.
explanation: Meaning of marginal costMarginal cost is the instantaneous rate of change of total cost with respect to the number of items produced.Differentiation of the cost function$$MC=C'(x)=0.012x^2+0.04x+25$$Substitution of the production levelAt $x=10$,$$MC=0.012(10)^2+0.04(10)+25$$Calculation$$MC=1.2+0.4+25=26.6$$Final resultThe marginal-cost function is $MC=0.012x^2+0.04x+25$, and the marginal cost at a production level of $10$ items is ₹$26.60$ per additional item.
